newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: African ministers meet to prepare for OAU summit.
newsitem.headline: African ministers meet to prepare for OAU summit.

text.p: African foreign ministers began a two-day conference in Zimbabwe on Thursday to prepare for an Organisation of African Unity summit in Harare next week.

OAU and Zimbabwean government officials said there were around 20 ministers from the 53-member organisation in the closed door meeting, but added that they were still expecting more ministers, including from Laurent Kabila's Democratic Republic of Congo, to come for the two-day ministerial conference.
The ministers were discussing among other issues, the crisis in the Great Lakes region, the coup in Sierra Leone and political developments in Somalia and Angola.
The same issues are on agenda of the June 2-4 OAU summit.
